dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you mulling over, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you remember Gorou's fluffy ears?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon really wants something like that... Or maybe horns similar to the ones Ganyu has. Ganyu's horns are pretty cute as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me see, hmm... Oh, I found something!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Really? Aw, {NICKNAME}, Paimon always knew you were reliable!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ta-da! I present to you the Tusk of Monoceros Caeli!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* If Paimon can't have Gorou's fluffy ears, then maybe at least something like his fluffy tail...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bubadada! Here you go — Tail of Boreas!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Not that! Also, combining those two is definitely not the look Paimon is going for!
